"The slightest email from a dissatisfied parent will lead to a suspension": a new strike is called for Monday in after-school programs in Paris. The activity leaders are "at their breaking point," reports a union representative. The cause is the plan of the new mayor of Paris, Emmanuel Grégoire, and the climate of widespread suspicion towards staff since the revelations of several cases of physical and sexual violence in these facilities. The seven unions representing after-school employees in Paris are calling for a strike from Monday, May 11th to May 22nd, according to reports from France Inter and France Culture. The inter-union group is not convinced by the €20 million plan of the new mayor, Emmanuel Grégoire. She also denounces a climate of widespread suspicion that has plagued staff since the revelations of physical and sexual violence in the fall of 2025. "The slightest email from a disgruntled parent will lead to a suspension," asserts Éric Leclerc, director of after-school programs and a representative for the Supap-FSU union, speaking on France Inter radio. The activity leaders have become extremely agitated, "on the verge of a breakdown," he recounts. "For example: two children are about to fight in the playground, and the activity leader will face a dilemma. Do I separate the children, risking grabbing a child's shoulder or arm and being accused of violence? If a kindergarten child has an accident, like wetting the bed, do I change their diaper?"
Suspended for raising his voice?

“What we’re contesting is that as soon as there’s a report about anything, they’re automatically suspended,” Alexandre Herzog, after-school program director at a Parisian school and CGT union representative, told France Culture. “Today, colleagues are suspended for raising their voices without even yelling at a child. We can’t treat an employee who raised their voice, shouted, or grabbed a child roughly the same way as another employee who knowingly harmed a child,” he lamented.

“When a child speaks up, it’s because they’ve reported something, and it’s normal for an institution to take precautionary measures while it investigates the facts,” countered Barka Zerouali. Zerouali, who co-founded the #MeTooÉcole collective in November 2025, doesn’t understand the unions’ demands. According to her, demanding an end to the systematic suspension of staff when reports do not concern sexual violence is tantamount to questioning the children's word.

"Temporarily suspending an adult is not condemning them, it's applying a precautionary principle." Barka Zerouali, co-founder of the #MeTooSchool collective, told France Culture that this is "what we've been fighting for for several months: zero tolerance," she added.

For the mayor's office, the idea is to restore trust. Contacted by France Inter, the Paris mayor's office acknowledged that it is taking no risks. "It's a precautionary principle because a complaint could be filed, and so we suspend the suspension while the situation is clarified," explained Anne-Claire Boux, deputy mayor of Paris in charge of school affairs and early childhood. The measures taken by the City of Paris are intended "to restore this trust." The elected official stated, however, that she is prepared to exercise more discretion when it comes to abrupt gestures, rather than physical violence. She also promised announcements in July regarding working conditions, reducing job insecurity, and other union demands. Two-thirds of the 16,000 after-school staff in Paris are temporary workers. Unions expect a well-supported strike, reports France Inter. Each staff member can walk out for just one hour a day, at lunchtime for example, which is enough to disrupt childcare. The unions also plan to demonstrate on May 19 in front of the Paris Department of School Affairs (DASCO).

Since the beginning of 2026, 78 City of Paris employees have been suspended from their duties in Parisian schools, 31 of them for suspected sexual abuse, figures which, according to Emmanuel Grégoire, reflect a "systemic" nature of the problem. A top priority at the start of his term, the new Socialist mayor of Paris will visit the Saint-Dominique school (7th arrondissement) on Monday to meet with staff and families, following the filing of some thirty complaints of rape, sexual assault, and violence against children at this nursery school.

CAPTION_ENDORSE: Labor protest blocks area outside three Ebola treatment centers in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo
MESSAGE_TEXT:
Ebola response workers in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo staged protests outside three treatment centres on Thursday, accusing authorities of failing to properly pay them for their work during the country’s latest outbreak.
The outbreak, declared on May 15, has infected 1,759 people and killed 600, according to government figures released on Wednesday.
The World Health Organization said this week that transmission of the rare Ebola strain was still ongoing. The strain has no approved vaccine or cure and kills between 30% and 50% of those infected.
Dozens of Ebola response workers gathered outside the Centre Medical Evangelique, Elikya and Salama treatment centres in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, the area hardest hit by the outbreak.
Police dispersed one of the demonstrations outside the Centre Medical Evangelique. It was not immediately clear whether the protests affected operations at the treatment centres.
Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba acknowledged problems in what he described as the “human resources pillar” of the response, saying authorities were working to update and verify lists of workers who needed to be paid.
A Congolese health official, speaking on condition of anonymity because he was not authorised to talk to the media, said talks were continuing with workers who had threatened to strike, but that no strike had begun.
In a July 5 letter addressed to Ituri’s governor and health officials, Ebola response workers said they had not been paid for services provided since the outbreak began.
They said the delays had caused “significant socio-economic difficulties” and worsened their living conditions.
The workers also complained that compensation rates were too low given the risks and workload involved in the Ebola response. They demanded higher daily allowances and called for the removal of income tax deductions, arguing that the payments were bonuses rather than salaries.

MESSAGE_TEXT:
The growing militancy among workers reflects the severity of the crisis gripping their livelihoods.
CABUYAO, Laguna — Progressive labor groups will have coordinated nationwide protests on Labor Day, denouncing what they describe as worsening economic hardship, imperialist war, and intensifying state repression under the Marcos, Jr. administration.
In an April 27 statement, Kilusang Mayo Uno (KMU), All Workers Unity and Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) said that thousands of workers are expected to take to the streets in Metro Manila and key regions, with the main mobilization set to converge at Mendiola.
The groups said that this year’s Labor Day protests will highlight long-standing demands for a national living wage, urgent price controls on basic goods, and sufficient state subsidies amid a deepening socioeconomic crisis. They will also denounce the ongoing war involving the United States and Israel against Iran which they said further burdens workers through rising global prices and heightened geopolitical tensions.
Simultaneous actions are slated in Central Luzon, CALABARZON, Bicol, Negros, Cebu, Panay, and Davao, signaling a “broadening and intensifying” wave of workers’ resistance.
In the run-up to May 1, workers from various industries, including manufacturing, semiconductors, garments, food processing, construction, shipping, and business process outsourcing, held coordinated protest actions under the banner of Protestang Bayan (people’s protest). These took the form of breaktime and after-work demonstrations, symbolic protests such as ribbon wearings and black shirt days, and a strike, amplifying calls for immediate economic relief.
KMU chairperson Jerome Adonis said that the growing militancy among workers reflects the severity of the crisis gripping their livelihoods. “The movement of workers is gaining strength because of the crisis. They feel its impact on their livelihoods and families, and the need to fight back.”
KMU cited the simultaneous filing of wage hike petitions in the National Capital Region, Region IV-A, and Central Luzon as proof that workers nationwide are confronting similar economic conditions marked by low wages and soaring prices.
Adonis said that recent labor victories, including a strike by Kowloon restaurant workers, as evidence that collective action can yield gains. He called on workers to unite and mobilize on Labor Day.
KMU criticized the Marcos, Jr. administration for “prioritizing repressive policies over addressing the people’s demands.” It cited crackdowns on urban poor communities under the Department of the Interior and Local Government’s (DILG) Safer Cities Initiative, as well as reported human rights violations under the National Action Plan for Unity, Peace, and Development in Negros and other rural areas.
“While the government refuses to heed the people’s demands, it continues to unleash violence against them,” Adonis said.
Labor groups are expected to assemble along España Boulevard before marching toward Mendiola where they will join other labor groups and people’s organizations in marking International Labor Day.
KMU said that the May Day protests will bring workers’ grievances, ranging from low wages and job insecurity to state violence, directly to the seat of power as calls for accountability intensify amid overlapping economic and political crises. (RTS, DAA)

MESSAGE_TEXT:
ORIZABA, Ver., 6 de julio de 2026.- Familiares y amigos de Jesús Alberto Viveros Caballero, señalado por el homicidio de una maestra, se manifestaron este lunes en las instalaciones de la Ciudad Judicial de Orizaba, donde estaba programada la audiencia de juicio del proceso penal que enfrenta.
Durante la protesta exigieron que el procedimiento avance sin más retrasos y solicitaron que las autoridades valoren las pruebas que favorecerían al imputado.
La madre de Jesús Alberto, Margarita Viveros Caballero, comentó que su hijo lleva tres años y cuatro meses y medio privado de la libertad, y acusó que el proceso ha estado marcado por constantes diferimientos de audiencias.
«Mi hijo lleva tres años, cuatro meses y medio privado de su libertad. Constantemente aplazan las audiencias y de última hora nos notifican los cambios», expresó.
Durante la manifestación, Margarita Viveros sostuvo que la defensa cuenta con videos captados por cámaras de vigilancia ubicadas cerca del negocio de su hijo, los cuales demostrarían que él se encontraba en ese sitio cuando ocurrieron los hechos que se investigan.
«No puede estar en dos lugares al mismo tiempo. Las cámaras muestran que estaba en su negocio y no donde ocurrió el homicidio», aseguró.
Asimismo, hizo un llamado a la gobernadora de Veracruz, a la Fiscalía General del Estado y al Poder Judicial para que el expediente sea revisado con imparcialidad y el juicio continúe sin nuevos aplazamientos.
Los manifestantes permanecieron a las afueras de la Ciudad Judicial mientras esperaban el desarrollo de la audiencia, con la expectativa de que ésta no volviera a ser suspendida.
También responsabilizaron a la Fiscalía de los constantes diferimientos y señalaron que, a su consideración, el proceso se ha prolongado de manera injustificada.
TRANSLATED_TEXT:
ORIZABA, Veracruz, July 6, 2026 – Family and friends of Jesús Alberto Viveros Caballero, accused of murdering a teacher, protested this Monday at the Orizaba Judicial City, where his trial hearing was scheduled.

During the protest, they demanded that the proceedings move forward without further delays and requested that the authorities consider the evidence that would favor the accused.

Jesús Alberto's mother, Margarita Viveros Caballero, stated that her son has been deprived of his freedom for three years and four and a half months, and accused the court of constantly postponing hearings.

"My son has been deprived of his freedom for three years, four and a half months. They constantly postpone the hearings and notify us of the changes at the last minute," she said. During the demonstration, Margarita Viveros maintained that the defense has video footage from security cameras located near her son's business, which would prove that he was there when the events under investigation took place.

"He can't be in two places at the same time. The cameras show that he was at his business and not where the homicide occurred," she asserted.

She also called on the Governor of Veracruz, the State Attorney General's Office, and the Judiciary to review the case impartially and ensure the trial continues without further postponements.

The demonstrators remained outside the Judicial City while awaiting the hearing, hoping it would not be suspended again.

They also blamed the Attorney General's Office for the constant delays and stated that, in their view, the process has been unjustifiably prolonged.

La medida afecta directamente al Hospital Universitario de Navarra y al Hospital Reina Sofía de Tudela, al que se han sumado más de una docena de servicios. La huelga afectará a toda la actividad laboral de médicos y se llevará a cabo, de lunes a viernes, entre las tres y veinte minutos de la tarde y las diez de la noche. Habrá dos semanas en las que no se realizarán estos paros que serán las del 18 de mayo y la del 15 de junio. Estos paros se traducen, en la práctica, en anulación de citas médicas para los ciudadanos. A día de hoy la resolución del conflicto entre el Departamento de Salud, las diferentes direcciones generales afectadas y el Sindicato Médicos parece lejana.
Resquicios para el acuerdo

La situación, a juicio del presidente del Colegio de Médicos, es "insostenible" y de ahí que los profesionales hayan optado por llevar sus demandas a la última expresión. "La verdad es que se ha llegado a una situación casi insostenible y tenemos que arrimar todos el hombro y poner algo de nuestra parte para poder colaborar y llevar esto a buen término".
Más tiempo por consulta
El presidente del Colegio de Médicos de Navarra incide en que el objetivo de médicos y ciudadanos es el mismo, que es ampliar y mejorar la atención al paciente: "Puede que con el conflicto cambie la opinión de los ciudadanos, pero se está haciendo para mejorar la sanidad y que los médicos vuelvan a tener el tiempo suficiente para poder atender a sus pacientes. Una de las principales quejas de los pacientes, aunque haya una buena valoración de los profesionales, es que no se dedica el tiempo suficiente". Antes las guardias se consideraban tiempo de dedicación, con posibilidad de trabajar, pero actualmente durante las guardias se trabaja las 24 horas, con lo cual no son comparables a las que hacíamos hace 20 años. Y los descansos no son los mismos tampoco, con lo cual eso habría que modificarlo, reestructurarlo. Cambiar las guardias y cambiarlo por turnos, como hay en otros estamentos", finaliza.

One of the main complaints from patients, despite a positive assessment of the professionals, is that not enough time is dedicated to them." In this regard, Tomás Rubio advocates for improving the current system and adapting to the new situation: "We continue with 24-hour on-call programs. Previously, on-call shifts were considered dedicated time, with the possibility of working, but currently, during on-call shifts, we work 24 hours a day, so they are not comparable to those we did 20 years ago. And the rest periods are not the same either, so this needs to be modified, restructured. On-call shifts should be changed to rotating shifts, as is done in other sectors," he concludes.

MESSAGE_TEXT:
Policías disuelven manifestación de productores de frijol en Zacatecas
Autoridades estatales y federales aseguran cumplimiento de acuerdos y atribuyen protestas a intereses políticos.
ZACATECAS, Zac., mayo 9 (EL UNIVERSAL).- En una nueva jornada de protestas y al cumplirse el tercer día de manifestaciones de un grupo de productores de frijol en Zacatecas, la tarde de este sábado, se registró una confrontación entre los manifestantes y fuerzas policiales, al momento de que se aplicó el operativo para retirar la maquinaria agrícola del lugar, que dejó un saldo de cuatro personas detenidas, entre ellas, dos de los líderes.
Los hechos se registraron cerca de las inmediaciones del Multiforo, ubicado en la capital de Zacatecas, donde el gobierno tiene programado el concierto del cantante Ricardo Montaner para festejar el Día de las Madres.
Desde temprana hora al lugar arribó un contingente de productores con el objetivo de impedir que se realizara el evento como forma de presión a las autoridades para que se les cumpla sus exigencias de que se les compre a 27 pesos el kilo de frijol a los integrantes de su agrupación.
A esta manifestación también se unieron personas de otros sectores, principalmente un grupo de universitarios y feministas, al manifestar respaldo a la demanda de los agricultores, tras señalar que durante las acciones se habían realizado actos de represión.

Debido a que el perímetro de esa área fue asegurado con vallas y vigilado por elementos de seguridad, los manifestantes se apostaron con sus tractores con el objetivo de incursionar hasta el multiforo.
Pasadas las 15:00 horas, cuando llegaron elementos antimotines, los ánimos se encendieron y más cuando comenzaron a llegar las grúas para realizar el retiro de las unidades agrícolas que habían colocado los manifestantes, quienes se resistieron a que movieran sus unidades y replegaron a los manifestantes.
Dentro de los detenidos que mencionaban figuraban varios agricultores, entre ellos, uno de los líderes, Isaías Castro, así como varios jóvenes universitarios, y los manifestantes pedían su inmediata liberación.
Postura oficial
Sobre estos hechos, la Vocería de la Mesa de Construcción de Paz y Seguridad informó que, previo a la realización del concierto programado en la zona del Multiforo, se desplegó un operativo preventivo de seguridad y vialidad sobre la avenida Preparatoria, en la colonia Agronómica II, derivado de la presencia de un grupo de agricultores que realizaban una manifestación en el lugar.
Se menciona que "elementos de seguridad establecieron comunicación con los manifestantes para solicitar el retiro voluntario de vehículos que obstruían la vialidad y el acceso, a fin de evitar afectaciones mayores. Sin embargo, ante la negativa de mover las unidades, se procedió conforme a la ley para restablecer la movilidad".
El comunicado refiere que "se registraron momentos de tensión y jaloneos entre algunos participantes", pero asegura que "la actuación policial se realizó bajo protocolos de legalidad, contención y respeto irrestricto a los derechos humanos".
Respecto a las detenciones, precisa que fueron siete personas: cuatro hombres y tres mujeres, y se argumenta que se fue "por faltas administrativas y conductas relacionadas con obstrucción de la vía pública; permanecer y circular en zonas prohibidas; no presentar documentación correspondiente de los vehículos y resistencia a particulares".
El boletín menciona que "fueron aseguradas tres camionetas, dos tractores y un remolque, debido a que algunas unidades se encontraban estacionadas o circulando en áreas restringidas" y se precisa que "en todo momento se contó con la presencia y acompañamiento de personal de Derechos Humanos de la Fiscalía General de Justicia del Estado (FGJEZ), quienes observaron el desarrollo de las actuaciones".
Reactivan protestas y respuesta gubernamental
Cabe mencionar que el pasado jueves, este grupo de productores hace dos meses realizaron una serie de protestas y el 29 de marzo se retiraron tras firmar un acuerdo ante notario público, donde el gobierno federal se comprometía a recibir mil 500 toneladas de frijol de 300 agricultores de esa agrupación y serían beneficiados con el precio de garantía que pagó el gobierno federal a 27 mil pesos la tonelada.
Sin embargo, el pasado jueves, nuevamente reaparecieron con nuevas protestas que iniciaron en la Legislatura de Zacatecas, al denunciar que se habían incumplido los acuerdos que se habían pactado. Argumentaron que las autoridades no les estaban recibiendo su frijol y que no se estaba respetando el precio de garantía, ya que se los querían pagar a 16 mil pesos la tonelada y exigían respuesta a sus demandas.
Al irrumpir la sesión legislativa, los inconformes encararon al diputado local Jesús Padilla, a quien acusaron de ser "un coyote" que presuntamente fue de los principales beneficiados de los recursos destinados para el frijol, en complicidad con Oláis Ávila, jefe de operaciones de Alimentación para el Bienestar.
Ayer realizaron varias manifestaciones; incluso, un grupo de productores ingresó a un restaurante donde comía la diputada federal de Morena, Soledad Luévano, así como a Ernesto González Romo, secretario de la Función Pública estatal, a quienes exigían que intervinieran.
Advirtieron que mantendrían sus protestas y que, si no recibían respuesta para este el próximo lunes 11 de mayo, radicalizarían las acciones con la frase "va a arder Zacatecas".
El gobierno federal, a través de un comunicado de Alimentación para el Bienestar, dio respuesta a la situación de Zacatecas, donde aclara al grupo de productores manifestantes que no había incumplimiento alguno, al precisar que en total se dio atención a 441 productores, con quienes se concretó el acopio de más de mil 950 toneladas de frijol a precio de 27 mil pesos por tonelada.
También se aclara que este acuerdo se mantuvo a ese precio del anterior esquema, al señalar que actualmente, en la ampliación de 10 mil toneladas, el precio de garantía es a 16 mil pesos la tonelada, precio que es el que sigue vigente.
Tras este anuncio, este sábado también en un video, el secretario general del gobierno de Zacatecas, Rodrigo Reyes Mugüerza, aclaró que las manifestaciones de esta agrupación ya no tenían sustento, debido a que se ha cumplido con el convenio pactado el 29 de marzo, al señalar que incluso se excedió el apoyo, porque el compromiso pactado era de mil 500 toneladas y el total fueron 450 toneladas más, así como 141 productores más de lo acordado.
Incluso, aseguró que se había detectado que detrás de este movimiento había otros intereses políticos que había aprovechado la oposición, principalmente, señaló al PAN, de tener intereses en intervenir en este movimiento.
El funcionario estatal también negó que él hubiera interpuesto una denuncia contra los productores de frijol ante la Fiscalía de Zacatecas para solicitar medidas de protección.
Mencionó que quienes solicitaron esas medidas fueron trabajadores de la Secretaría General de Gobierno, debido a que supuestamente el grupo de productores ya no tenía una manifestación pacífica, porque se estaba recurriendo a la violencia y en esos actos acudieron a Palacio de Gobierno y amenazaron al personal con frases: "Mátenlo, amárrenlo, vamos a lanzarles una bomba".
TRANSLATED_TEXT:
Police disperse bean farmers' protest in Zacatecas
State and federal authorities assert compliance with agreements and attribute protests to political interests.

ZACATECAS, Zac., May 9 (EL UNIVERSAL) - On the third day of protests by a group of bean farmers in Zacatecas, a confrontation occurred Saturday afternoon between the demonstrators and police forces during an operation to remove agricultural machinery from the site. Four people were arrested, including two of the protest leaders.

The incident took place near the Multiforo, located in the city of Zacatecas, where the government has scheduled a concert by singer Ricardo Montaner to celebrate Mother's Day. Early this morning, a group of farmers arrived at the site with the aim of preventing the event from taking place. This was a way to pressure the authorities to meet their demand that their farmers' beans be purchased at 27 pesos per kilo.

People from other sectors, mainly a group of university students and feminists, joined the demonstration, expressing their support for the farmers' demands and claiming that acts of repression had occurred during the protests.

Because the perimeter of the area was secured with fences and guarded by security personnel, the protesters positioned themselves with their tractors, intending to drive their tractors into the venue.

After 3:00 PM, when riot police arrived, tensions flared, especially when tow trucks began arriving to remove the agricultural vehicles that the protesters had placed there. The protesters resisted having their vehicles moved and pushed back the demonstrators.
Among those detained were several farmers, including one of their leaders, Isaías Castro, as well as several university students, and the protesters demanded their immediate release.

Official Statement
Regarding these events, the spokesperson for the Peace and Security Commission reported that, prior to the concert scheduled at the Multiforo venue, a preventative security and traffic operation was deployed on Preparatoria Avenue in the Agronómica II neighborhood, due to the presence of a group of farmers holding a demonstration in the area.

It is mentioned that "security personnel established communication with the protesters to request the voluntary removal of vehicles obstructing traffic and access, in order to avoid further disruptions. However, given their refusal to move the vehicles, the police proceeded according to the law to restore traffic flow."

The statement indicates that "there were moments of tension and scuffles among some participants," but assures that "the police action was carried out under protocols of legality, restraint, and strict respect for human rights."

Regarding the arrests, it specifies that seven people were detained: four men and three women, and it is stated that they were arrested "for administrative offenses and conduct related to obstructing public roads; remaining and circulating in prohibited areas; failing to present the corresponding vehicle documentation; and resisting arrest."

The bulletin mentions that "three pickup trucks, two tractors, and a trailer were seized because some of the vehicles were parked or driving in restricted areas," and specifies that "human rights personnel from the Zacatecas State Attorney General's Office (FGJEZ) were present and accompanied at all times, observing the proceedings."

Protests and Government Response Reactivated
It should be noted that this group of producers held a series of protests two months ago, and on March 29, they withdrew after signing an agreement before a notary public. In this agreement, the federal government committed to receiving 1,500 tons of beans from 300 farmers in the group, who would benefit from the guaranteed price of 27,000 pesos per ton paid by the federal government.

However, last Thursday, they reappeared with new protests, beginning at the Zacatecas State Legislature, denouncing the breach of the agreements. They argued that the authorities were not accepting their beans and that the guaranteed price was not being respected, as they were being offered only 16,000 pesos per ton. They demanded a response to their demands.

Upon disrupting the legislative session, the protesters confronted local deputy Jesús Padilla, whom they accused of being a "coyote" (a middleman) who allegedly benefited from the funds allocated for beans, in collusion with Oláis Ávila, head of operations for the Food for Well-being program.

Yesterday, they held several demonstrations; a group of producers even entered a restaurant where Morena federal deputy Soledad Luévano and Ernesto González Romo, the state secretary of public administration, were eating, demanding their intervention.

They warned that they would continue their protests and that if they did not receive a response by Monday, May 11, they would escalate their actions, declaring, "Zacatecas is going to burn." The federal government, through a statement from the Food for Well-being program, responded to the situation in Zacatecas, clarifying to the group of protesting producers that there had been no breach of contract. The statement specified that a total of 441 producers received assistance, resulting in the purchase of more than 1,950 tons of beans at a price of 27,000 pesos per ton.

It was also clarified that this price was maintained under the previous agreement, and that currently, with the expansion of the program to include 10,000 tons, the guaranteed price is 16,000 pesos per ton, which remains in effect.

Following this announcement, also in a video released this Saturday, the Secretary General of the Zacatecas government, Rodrigo Reyes Mugüerza, clarified that the protests by this group were no longer justified, given that the agreement reached on March 29 had been fulfilled. He pointed out that the support had even been exceeded, as the agreed-upon commitment was for 1,500 tons, but the total delivered was 450 tons more, along with 141 more producers than originally agreed upon.

He further asserted that it had been detected that other political interests were behind this movement, which the opposition, particularly the PAN party, had exploited, specifically pointing to their interest in interfering in the movement.

The state official also denied having filed a complaint against the bean producers with the Zacatecas Prosecutor's Office to request protective measures. He mentioned that those who requested these measures were employees of the General Secretariat of the Government, because supposedly the group of producers was no longer demonstrating peacefully, as they were resorting to violence. During these acts, they went to the Government Palace and threatened the staff with phrases like, "Kill him, tie him up, we're going to throw a bomb at him."

Celadores de Norte de Santander exigen revocar resolución que modifica sus condiciones laborales
El sindicato asegura que la medida afecta a 110 trabajadores.
Norte de Santander.
Con una protesta pacífica en la Gobernación de Norte de Santander, cerca de 110 celadores de las instituciones educativas oficiales del departamento exigieron la revocatoria de la Resolución 093 del 4 de junio de 2026, al considerar que la medida modifica las condiciones laborales y salariales que, aseguran, han mantenido durante más de 45 años.
La jornada estuvo acompañada por integrantes del Sindicato Nacional de Trabajadores y Empleados de la Educación (Sintrenal), quienes, mientras adelantaban una mesa de diálogo con representantes jurídicos de la Gobernación y la Secretaría de Educación, solicitaron al gobernador William Villamizar reconsiderar la decisión.
En diálogo con Caracol Radio, Ramiro Castro Angarita, representante de los celadores de los colegios públicos del departamento, explicó que la principal petición del sindicato es que se deje sin efectos la resolución y se mantenga el reconocimiento de las horas extras, recargos nocturnos, dominicales y festivos.
“Hoy queremos dirigirnos muy especialmente al señor gobernador William Villamizar para solicitar que se revoque la Resolución 093 del 4 de junio de 2026 y se reconsidere dejar en normalidad la jornada laboral que contemple el reconocimiento de las horas extras, recargos nocturnos, dominicales y festivos", manifestó.
El vocero aseguró que la preocupación de los trabajadores radica en que la resolución, según indicó, desconoce factores salariales que hacen parte de su remuneración desde hace más de cuatro décadas.
“Nos quieren desconocer factores laborales que hemos venido devengando durante más de 45 años, como son las 50 horas extras, el recargo nocturno por ser habitual y permanente la jornada laboral de seis de la tarde a seis de la mañana, y los dominicales y festivos que hemos venido recibiendo", señaló.
Castro indicó que la decisión tendría repercusiones económicas para los trabajadores y sus familias, ya que muchos adquirieron compromisos financieros teniendo en cuenta esos ingresos.
“Hay compañeros que ya están afectados, algunos son hipertensos y diabéticos. Incluso uno de ellos tuvo que ser hospitalizado. Además, estamos pagando vivienda y nuestros hijos están en la universidad con base en esos factores salariales, por eso esperamos que el gobernador reconsidere la decisión", agregó.
Los manifestantes permanecieron en las instalaciones de la Gobernación a la espera de los resultados de la reunión entre los equipos jurídicos de ambas partes, con la expectativa de alcanzar un acuerdo que permita resolver el conflicto y revisar la aplicación de la Resolución 093.

School custodians in Norte de Santander demand the revocation of a resolution that modifies their working conditions.
The union claims the measure affects 110 workers.

Norte de Santander.
With a peaceful protest at the Governor's Office of Norte de Santander, approximately 110 custodians from the department's public schools demanded the revocation of Resolution 093 of June 4, 2026. They argue that the measure modifies the working conditions and salaries they claim to have maintained for more than 45 years.

The protest was supported by members of the National Union of Education Workers and Employees (Sintrenal), who, while holding a dialogue with legal representatives from the Governor's Office and the Department of Education, asked Governor William Villamizar to reconsider the decision.

In an interview with Caracol Radio, Ramiro Castro Angarita, representative of the custodians of public schools in the department, explained that the union's main request is that the resolution be revoked and that overtime, night shift differentials, and Sunday and holiday pay be reinstated.

"Today we want to address Governor William Villamizar specifically to request that Resolution 093 of June 4, 2026, be revoked and that the work schedule be reinstated, including the recognition of overtime, night shift differentials, and Sunday and holiday pay," he stated.

The spokesperson asserted that the workers' concern stems from the fact that the resolution, he indicated, disregards salary factors that have been part of their compensation for more than four decades. “They want to disregard labor benefits we've been accruing for over 45 years, such as the 50 hours of overtime, the night shift differential due to the regular and permanent work schedule of 6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m., and the Sunday and holiday pay we've been receiving,” he stated.

Castro indicated that the decision would have economic repercussions for the workers and their families, as many had made financial commitments based on these earnings.

“Some of our colleagues are already affected; some have hypertension and diabetes. One even had to be hospitalized. Furthermore, we're paying for housing, and our children are in university, all thanks to these salaries. That's why we hope the governor will reconsider his decision,” he added.

The protesters remained at the Governor's office awaiting the results of the meeting between the legal teams of both sides, hoping to reach an agreement that would resolve the conflict and allow for a review of the application of Resolution 093.

Publié le
Dans la continuité des manifestations organisées devant la cité judiciaire depuis la mort de Lyhanna, le collectif d'associations dijonnaises pour la protection de l'enfance organise ce samedi une mobilisation citoyenne place François Rude. Une réunion est également organisée à Chatillon-sur-Seine.
Dans le cadre de la mobilisation nationale du samedi 4 juillet en faveur d'une loi-cadre intégrale sur les violences faites aux femmes et aux enfants, les associatison dijonnaises de protection des enfants appellent à se rassembler entre 9h30 et 12h30 place François Rude.
De la prévention plutôt qu'une marche en ville
Pas de marche citoyenne, donc, ce samedi. Les associations ont décidé de privilégier un lieu en centre-ville, pour attirer les passent.es, sensibiliser et échanger autour d'ateliers pédagogiques destinés à la fois aux publics adulte et enfant. Une démarche qui s'inscrit directement dans le sillage des rassemblements successifs, chaque lundi soir, organisé devant les tribunaux partout en France.
Le point de départ, c'est encore et toujours l'affaire Lyhanna, cette adolescente violée et tuée dont le sort a ému toute la France, et la volonté de maintenir la pression sur le gouvernement, pour que la loi intégrale sur les violences sexistes et sexuelles soit bel et bien examinée et votée à l'automne, comme s'y est engagé le premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu.
Ce texte de loi, déjà présenté au parlement en décembre 2025, reprend pour l'essentiel les recommandations de la Ciivise, visant à mieux protéger les enfants, mais aussi toutes les victimes de violences, à mieux prévenir ces violences également. Les associations réclament que ce projet de loi soit maintenu dans toute son ambition.
A Chatillon sur Seine, des victimes de violences mobilisées
Plus au nord de la Côte-d'Or, la ville de Chatillon-sur-Seine apportera également sa pierre à l'édifice de la mobilisation citoyenne nationale. Samedi 4 juillet, une grande manifestation est prévue pour la protection des mineurs et des femmes contre les violences, à l'initiative de "la parole accueillie", ce collectif né suite aux accusations de viols et d'agressions sexuelles visant l'ancien prêtre Yves Grosjean, qui avait officié à Châtillon dans les années 1990. Rendez-vous est donné à 10h30 à la salle des conférences pour une réunion d’information et d’échange.

Lyhanna Case: Citizen Mobilization in Dijon and Châtillon-sur-Seine this Saturday, July 4
Published on
Following the demonstrations organized in front of the courthouse since Lyhanna's death, the Dijon collective of child protection associations is organizing a citizen mobilization this Saturday at Place François Rude. A meeting is also being held in Châtillon-sur-Seine.

As part of the national mobilization on Saturday, July 4, in support of a comprehensive framework law on violence against women and children, Dijon child protection associations are calling for a gathering between 9:30 a.m. and 12:30 p.m. at Place François Rude.
Prevention Rather Than a City March
There will be no citizen march this Saturday. The associations have decided to focus on a location in the city center to attract passersby, raise awareness, and facilitate discussions through educational workshops for both adults and children. This initiative follows directly from the series of gatherings held every Monday evening in front of courthouses across France.

The starting point remains the Lyhanna case, the rape and murder of the teenage girl whose fate moved the entire nation, and the desire to maintain pressure on the government to ensure that the comprehensive law on gender-based and sexual violence is indeed examined and passed this fall, as Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu pledged.
This bill, already presented to parliament in December 2025, essentially incorporates the recommendations of the Interministerial Committee for the Fight against Violence Against Women (CIIVISE), aiming to better protect children, as well as all victims of violence, and to improve prevention of such violence. The associations are demanding that this bill be maintained in its full scope. In Châtillon-sur-Seine, victims of violence mobilize
Further north of the Côte-d'Or department, the town of Châtillon-sur-Seine will also contribute to the national citizen mobilization. On Saturday, July 4, a large demonstration is planned for the protection of minors and women against violence, organized by "La Parole Accueillée" (The Welcomed Word), a collective formed following accusations of rape and sexual assault against former priest Yves Grosjean, who served in Châtillon in the 1990s. The meeting will be held at 10:30 a.m. in the conference room for an information and discussion session.

IT expert Gent Progni gave a speech during the protest held in front of the Prime Minister's Office, where protesters demanded the removal of Prime Minister Edi Rama.
In his speech, Progni ironically mocked the increase in the price of soufflés, linking it to the concert of artist Kanye West, while adding that those who participated in the activity, according to him, have done the protest an honor.
He stated that, if there is a change of government, he will propose a law that he symbolically called the "soufljak law", adding that people who, according to him, have misused public funds should be held accountable.
Progni also said that a new report is being prepared to be filed with the Special Prosecution Office (SPAK), regarding a fund of 4 million euros, which he claims was given to a private company.

خرج عدد من تجار سوق أولاد ميمون، صباح الأربعاء فاتح يوليوز، في وقفة احتجاجية أمام مقر عمالة إقليم الناظور، للمطالبة بتدخل السلطات من أجل معالجة الاختلالات التي يعرفها السوق، والتي يقولون إنها تسببت في تراجع النشاط التجاري وإلحاق أضرار كبيرة بأصحاب المحلات.

A number of merchants from the Oulad Mimoun market held a protest on Wednesday morning, July 1st, in front of the Nador Provincial Headquarters, demanding the authorities intervene to address the problems plaguing the market. They pointed out that certain practices within the vicinity of Alley 10, including harassment of women and inappropriate behavior, tarnish the market's image and affect the comfort of both citizens and merchants. The protesters called on local and regional authorities to expedite the organization of the commercial space and clear the passageways leading to the market, ensuring respect for the law and protecting the rights of all stakeholders, including shop owners and vendors, while maintaining public order.

The participants emphasized that their demands stemmed from their desire to revitalize commercial activity in the Oulad Mimoun market and improve customer service. They warned that they would escalate their protests if the situation remained unresolved, including taking their demonstrations to the headquarters of the Eastern Region and displaying their goods on the sidewalks to highlight the extent of the damage they were suffering.

MESSAGE_TEXT:
SRINAGAR: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister and National Conference Vice President Omar Abdullah on Wednesday said the party’s proposed protest in New Delhi on July 20 demanding the restoration of statehood would go ahead as scheduled despite the demise of senior party leader and his uncle, Mustafa Kamal.
Speaking to reporters after paying tributes to Kamal, Abdullah said the party would honour his uncle’s wishes by continuing with the planned demonstration.
Statehood Protest Will Go Ahead as Scheduled Despite Uncle's Demise: CM Omar Abdullah pic.twitter.com/eHHwYuly7K
— JAMMU LINKS NEWS (@JAMMULINKS) July 15, 2026 “There will be no change in that. Neither would Mustafa Kamal have wanted any change,” Abdullah said.
He said Kamal’s health had deteriorated on July 11 and doctors had expressed serious concern over his condition. Despite this, National Conference President Farooq Abdullah had directed the party to continue with its political programme.
“Even when we knew about his critical condition, the party president said that whatever happened to Mustafa Sahib, we had to continue with our protest. Therefore, there is no question of cancelling the July 20 protest,” he said.
On whether the party had received permission from the Delhi authorities to hold the protest at Jantar Mantar, Abdullah said approval was still awaited.
“We are being made to wait. We know how to be patient. We will wait and also keep an alternate plan ready,” he said.
The Chief Minister, however, made it clear that the party’s schedule would remain unchanged.
“I have told my colleagues that we will definitely leave for Delhi on July 19. Even if we do not get permission for Jantar Mantar, we will reach Delhi, sit together and decide our next course of action there,” he said.
Describing Kamal’s demise as a personal and political loss, Abdullah recalled his contributions as a doctor, legislator and public servant. He said Kamal continued to run a free medical clinic in Tangmarg even while serving as Jammu and Kashmir’s Health Minister and dedicated his life to serving the poor.
Abdullah also highlighted Kamal’s political career, noting that he was elected to the Jammu and Kashmir Assembly from Tangmarg in 1987 and 1996 and later represented Patan and Hazratbal through by-elections.
He said the large turnout of mourners reflected the respect and affection Kamal had earned during his lifetime.

MESSAGE_TEXT:
Port-au-Prince, samedi 6 juin 2026 — Plusieurs dizaines de citoyens ont marché pacifiquement, samedi, dans les rues de Port-au-Prince, pour dénoncer les dérives constitutionnelles imputées au gouvernement de doublure dirigé par Alix Didier Fils-Aimé. À travers cette mobilisation, les protestataires ont voulu adresser un signal de mécontentement au pouvoir accusé de « multiplier les décisions arbitraires, sans légitimité populaire ni respect rigoureux de l’ordre constitutionnel établi« .
Cette marche intervient dans un climat institutionnel tendu, marqué notamment par l’installation contestée d’Uder Antoine à la direction générale du Conseil électoral provisoire. Pour plusieurs manifestants, cette décision constitue un passage en force destiné à affaiblir « l’autonomie » du CEP et à placer l’appareil électoral sous l’influence directe de la Primature.
La présence de Jacques Desrosiers vendredi à cette installation, alors que d’autres conseillers électoraux se sont tenus à distance, accentue les interrogations sur la cohésion réelle de l’institution.
Au centre des critiques figure la violation présumée des prérogatives constitutionnelles du CEP. La Constitution confie au Conseil électoral la responsabilité d’organiser et de contrôler les opérations électorales, ainsi que de préparer le cadre électoral relevant de sa compétence.
La marche pacifique du 6 juin traduit donc une inquiétude politique plus profonde : celle de voir les élections devenir un instrument de consolidation d’un pouvoir déjà contesté, plutôt qu’un mécanisme de retour à l’ordre démocratique réel.
TRANSLATED_TEXT:
Port-au-Prince, Saturday, June 6, 2026 — Several dozen citizens marched peacefully through the streets of Port-au-Prince on Saturday to denounce the constitutional abuses attributed to the puppet government led by Alix Didier Fils-Aimé. Through this mobilization, the protesters aimed to send a message of discontent to the government, which they accuse of "multiplying arbitrary decisions without popular legitimacy or strict respect for the established constitutional order."
This march comes amid a tense institutional climate, marked in particular by the contested appointment of Uder Antoine as Director General of the Provisional Electoral Council (CEP). For many demonstrators, this decision constitutes a power grab intended to weaken the CEP's "autonomy" and place the electoral apparatus under the direct influence of the Prime Minister's office.
The presence of Jacques Desrosiers at this appointment on Friday, while other electoral councilors kept their distance, raises further questions about the institution's true cohesion. At the heart of the criticism is the alleged violation of the CEP's constitutional prerogatives. The Constitution entrusts the Electoral Council with the responsibility of organizing and overseeing electoral operations, as well as preparing the electoral framework within its jurisdiction.
The peaceful march of June 6th thus reflects a deeper political concern: that elections will become an instrument for consolidating an already contested power, rather than a mechanism for restoring genuine democratic order.

CAPTION_ENDORSE: Mexican National Coordination of Education Workers demands government to respond to 79 demands within 24 hours
MESSAGE_TEXT:
Ciudad de México.- La Sección 22 de la Coordinadora Nacional de Trabajadores de la Educación (CNTE) emplazó al Gobierno federal a emitir, en un plazo máximo de 24 horas, una respuesta por escrito al pliego de 79 demandas.
Pese al bloqueo que el magisterio disidente mantuvo en el Aeropuerto de Oaxaca y en la Avenida Paseo de la Reforma, en la Ciudad de México, la mesa de diálogo en la Secretaría de Gobernación concluyó tras siete horas sin que las autoridades ofrecieran una respuesta a las exigencias sobre la entrega de útiles, mobiliario tecnológico y la contratación de personal para cubrir vacantes.
A su salida, Yenny Pérez , líder del sector, dio al Gobierno hasta las 20:00 horas de mañana, cuando se instala la asamblea estatal, para emitir una respuesta; de lo contrario, advirtió que las movilizaciones seguirán.
“A estas alturas, el Gobierno federal debería tener las respuestas, el emplazamiento que hicimos en esta mesa es que mañana tengan las respuestas por escrito, hoy no nos comprometimos a firmar ninguna minuta, porque es responsabilidad del Estado
“Para nosotros es importante que sea antes de nuestra asamblea estatal, así lo puedan dar en el momento que sea; sin embargo, en la estatal tiene que darse esa respuesta, será por la tarde noche, estamos calculando que sea a partir de las ocho de la noche”, exigió.
Indicó que el desplegado deberá contener fechas específicas para el cumplimiento del pago de los adeudos para los útiles escolares con los padres de familia, uniformes, procesos administrativos y contratación de profesores.
“Ya lo tienen; sin embargo, no dan precisamente la fecha y aquí lo que queremos es que ya sea específico”, indicó.
Pérez adelantó que mañana a Oaxaca le espera una serie de bloqueos carreteros, que se detendrán en la medida que el Gobierno dé respuestas a sus demandas.
“(Dependerán) de los avances, finalmente de las respuestas que tenga el Gobierno federal, ellos definirán hasta qué punto también accionamos porque finalmente nuestra asamblea estatal va a determinar acciones contundentes con base en las respuestas que nos den”, agregó.
Pese a las resoluciones a las que puedan llegar, informó que el movimiento en la Ciudad de México irá creciendo hasta alcanzar 20 por ciento de la “base magisterial” de la Sección 22 y sobre la marcha definirán hacia qué parte del Centro Histórico se extenderán, puesto que hoy les negaron abarcar más territorio sobre la Avenida 5 de mayo.
Afirmó que pese a las respuestas específicas que el Gobierno pudiera entregar a sus demandas, la 22 participará en la huelga nacional y plantón previsto para el 1 de junio.
En el encuentro estuvieron presentes la Secretaria de Gobernación, Rosa Icela Rodríguez; el Gobernador de Oaxaca, el morenista Salomón Jara; el Secretario de Educación, Mario Delgado; y el titular del ISSSTE, Martí Batres.
TRANSLATED_TEXT:
Mexico City – Section 22 of the National Coordinator of Education Workers (CNTE) has given the federal government 24 hours to issue a written response to its list of 79 demands.

Despite the blockades maintained by the dissident teachers at the Oaxaca Airport and on Paseo de la Reforma Avenue in Mexico City, the dialogue at the Ministry of the Interior concluded after seven hours without authorities offering a response to the demands regarding the delivery of school supplies, technological equipment, and the hiring of personnel to fill vacancies.

Upon leaving the meeting, Yenny Pérez, the sector's leader, gave the government until 8:00 p.m. tomorrow, when the state assembly convenes, to issue a response; otherwise, she warned that the protests will continue.

“At this point, the federal government should have the answers. The demand we made at this meeting is that they provide the answers in writing tomorrow. Today, we didn't commit to signing any minutes because that's the state's responsibility.

“For us, it's important that it be before our state assembly, so they can provide them at any time; however, that answer has to be given at the state assembly. It will be in the late afternoon or evening; we're estimating it will be after eight o'clock at night,” he demanded. He indicated that the statement should contain specific dates for the fulfillment of payments owed to parents for school supplies, uniforms, administrative processes, and teacher hiring.

“They already have it; However, they haven't given a specific date, and what we want here is for it to be concrete,” he stated.
Pérez announced that a series of highway blockades are expected in Oaxaca tomorrow, which will be suspended as the government responds to their demands.
“(They will depend) on the progress, ultimately on the responses from the federal government. They will define the extent to which we will also take action because, ultimately, our state assembly will determine decisive actions based on the responses we receive,” he added. Despite the resolutions they may reach, he reported that the movement in Mexico City will grow until it reaches 20 percent of the teachers' base of Section 22, and they will decide as they go along which part of the Historic Center they will extend to, since today they were denied permission to cover more territory on Avenida 5 de Mayo.
He affirmed that despite the specific responses the government might provide to their demands, Section 22 will participate in the national strike and sit-in planned for June 1.
Those present at the meeting included The Secretary of the Interior, Rosa Icela Rodríguez; the Governor of Oaxaca, Salomón Jara, a member of the Morena party; the Secretary of Education, Mario Delgado; and the head of the ISSSTE (Institute for Social Security and Services for State Workers), Martí Batres.

MESSAGE_TEXT:
Le personnel du groupe Air Liquide, à Ghlin, part en grève à la suite d'une restructuration : "Elle frappe de plein fouet le tissu social wallon"
Le personnel de 50 ans et plus est particulièrement ciblé, selon la délégation syndicale.
Emeline BerlierJournaliste
- Publié le 11-05-2026 à 08h04
Les travailleurs sont bien décidés à faire entendre leur voix. Ce lundi matin, la délégation syndicale de l'entreprise Air Liquide, dénonce une situation "alarmante" et sa mise en grève sur les sites wallons de Ghlin, Seraing et Liège. Alors que le groupe affiche une santé financière historique, avec un résultat net de 3,52 milliards d'euros et des dividendes en hausse constante, il engage parallèlement "une restructuration brutale qui frappe de plein fouet le tissu social wallon."
"Actuellement en phase 2 du plan Renault, des négociations et la mobilisation syndicale ont d'ores et déjà permis de sauver 5 emplois initialement promis à la suppression", annonce la délégation. "Cette avancée démontre que les licenciements ne sont pas une fatalité technique et qu'Air Liquide a les moyens de préserver l'emploi local lorsqu'il y est contraint." Pour les syndicats, le dossier fait état "de paradoxes insoutenables puisqu'un leader mondial de la transition énergétique choisit de sacrifier ses forces vives les plus expérimentées."
"Condamnation sociale des 50 ans et plus"
Concrètement, la majorité des travailleurs impactés par les plans Renault et Adapt ont plus de 50 ans. "Ce sont des femmes et des hommes qui ont consacré leur vie à la fiabilité de cette industrie. Les licencier aujourd'hui, dans un marché de l'emploi tendu pour les seniors, équivaut à une condamnation sociale." Pour les syndicats, il s'agit aussi d'un gâchis d'expertise. "Sur des sites classés Seveso, ces salariés ont développé une polyvalence et une culture de la sécurité indispensables. Leur départ forcé, au profit d'une automatisation outrancière et de délocalisations vers le Portugal (BSC), pose la question de la pérennité et de la sécurité de nos infrastructures industrielles."
Enfin, le syndicat estime qu'Air Liquide ne peut se prévaloir d'une stratégie de décarbonation "éthique" tout en pratiquant un arbitrage social low-cost. "La solidité financière du groupe lui donne l'obligation — et les moyens — de proposer des solutions de reclassement réelles et des fins de carrière dignes. Nous ne demandons pas la charité, mais la justice. Nous refusons que les travailleurs de 50 ans soient les variables d'ajustement d'un plan de rentabilité boursière et contraindre la direction d'Air Liquide à une responsabilité sociale à la hauteur de ses bénéfices."
Un leader mondial incontournable
Air Liquide est un leader mondial incontournable dans le secteur des gaz, technologies et services pour l'industrie et la santé. La société est un pilier stratégique de l'industrie et de la santé depuis 1902, sur la fourniture de molécules essentielles (Oxygène, Azote, hydrogène et Argon). La société alimente en effet de nombreux secteurs vitaux comme la chimie, l'automobile, la métallurgie, l'aéronautique, l'agroalimentaire en gaz et services associés. Le groupe est également un acteur majeur pour les services de la santé.
Présent dans 72 pays avec 67 800 collaborateurs, le groupe assure la continuité de la production dans les secteurs critiques comme les semi-conducteurs et la pétrochimie grâce à un réseau de pipelines étendu tel que celui reliant la France, la Belgique et les Pays-Bas. Ce réseau de plus de 2325 km permet par ailleurs une interconnexion entre les divers sites de production des 3 pays cités.
Il dispose d'une expertise dans la production d'hydrogène bas carbone, innove avec plus de 300 millions d'euros d'investissement et des centaines de brevets déposés chaque année pour répondre aux défis de demain et joue un rôle majeur dans la réduction des émissions de CO2 du monde industriel. Air Liquide et Holcim ont notamment signé un accord visant à décarboner la production de ciment grâce à un projet de captage du carbone en Belgique.
La situation est d'autant plus incompréhensible pour les travailleurs qu'au 14 mars dernier, la société affichait une solidité financière affirmée, dépassant même souvent les objectifs de son plan stratégique. "Cette réussite exceptionnelle est le fruit de l'engagement total des équipes de terrain. Pourtant, alors que les dividendes augmentent, l'investissement dans le capital humain local, lui, s'effondre."
Suppression de l'unité de production à Ghlin
Les trois sites wallons sont concernés. Ghlin ne fait donc pas exception. Ouvert en 1969 et classé Seveso, le site perd son unité de production (oxygène, azote, argon). "Le personnel, malgré sa polyvalence et son expertise unique, fait face à un licenciement collectif. Le risque ? Une vulnérabilité accrue du réseau oxygène pour les clients locaux." En raison des volumes stockés et de la nature des gaz, le site est classé "Seveso", ce qui implique des normes de sécurité et de surveillance extrêmement strictes.
À Seraing, il sera demandé au personnel de produire avec deux fois moins de personnel tandis qu'à Liège, le siège historique est vidé au profit du Business Service Center de Lisbonne. Une réalité que le personnel n'entend pas accepter sans tenter le tout pour le tout. Ce lundi, la délégation syndicale expose ses revendications, à savoir le maintien de l'emploi avec priorité au reclassement interne au sein du groupe ; un engagement pour les personnes de 50 ans et plus avec des solutions de fin de carrière dignes ou des garanties réelles de reclassement ; une cohérence éthique car "un leader de la transition bas-carbone ne peut laisser derrière lui un territoire brûlé socialement."
TRANSLATED_TEXT:
Air Liquide staff in Ghlin go on strike following a restructuring: "It's a devastating blow to the social fabric of Wallonia."
Employees aged 50 and over are particularly targeted, according to the union delegation.

Emeline Berlier, Journalist

- Published on 11-05-2026 at 08:04
The workers are determined to make their voices heard. This Monday morning, the Air Liquide union delegation denounced an "alarming" situation and called a strike at the Walloon sites of Ghlin, Seraing, and Liège. While the group boasts record financial health, with a net profit of €3.52 billion and steadily increasing dividends, it is simultaneously undertaking "a brutal restructuring that is a devastating blow to the social fabric of Wallonia." "Currently in phase 2 of the Renault plan, negotiations and union mobilization have already made it possible to save 5 jobs initially slated for elimination," the delegation announced. "This progress demonstrates that layoffs are not an inevitable technical outcome and that Air Liquide has the means to preserve local employment when forced to do so." For the unions, the situation reveals "untenable paradoxes, since a world leader in the energy transition is choosing to sacrifice its most experienced workforce."

"Social condemnation of those aged 50 and over"
In concrete terms, the majority of workers impacted by the Renault and Adapt plans are over 50. "These are men and women who have dedicated their lives to the reliability of this industry. Laying them off today, in a tight job market for older workers, amounts to social condemnation." For the unions, it is also a waste of expertise. "At Seveso-classified sites, these employees have developed essential versatility and a strong safety culture. Their forced departure, in favor of excessive automation and offshoring to Portugal (BSC), raises questions about the long-term viability and safety of our industrial infrastructure."

Finally, the union believes that Air Liquide cannot claim to have an "ethical" decarbonization strategy while practicing low-cost social compromise. "The group's financial strength gives it the obligation—and the means—to offer real redeployment solutions and dignified retirement options. We are not asking for charity, but for justice. We refuse to allow 50-year-old workers to be the variables in a stock market profitability plan and demand that Air Liquide's management demonstrate a level of social responsibility commensurate with its profits."

A key global leader
Air Liquide is a key global leader in the gas, technology, and services sector for industry and healthcare. The company has been a strategic pillar of industry and healthcare since 1902, supplying essential molecules (oxygen, nitrogen, hydrogen, and argon). It provides gas and related services to numerous vital sectors, including chemicals, automotive, metallurgy, aerospace, and food processing. The group is also a major player in healthcare services. Operating in 72 countries with 67,800 employees, the group ensures continuous production in critical sectors such as semiconductors and petrochemicals through an extensive pipeline network, including the one connecting France, Belgium, and the Netherlands. This network, spanning over 2,325 km, also enables interconnection between the various production sites in these three countries.

It possesses expertise in low-carbon hydrogen production, innovates with over €300 million in investment and hundreds of patents filed each year to meet tomorrow's challenges, and plays a major role in reducing CO2 emissions from industry. Air Liquide and Holcim notably signed an agreement to decarbonize cement production through a carbon capture project in Belgium.

The situation is all the more incomprehensible to the workers given that, as of March 14th, the company displayed strong financial health, often even exceeding the objectives of its strategic plan. "This exceptional success is the result of the total commitment of the field teams. Yet, while dividends are increasing, investment in local human capital is collapsing."
Closure of the production unit in Ghlin
All three Walloon sites are affected. Ghlin is therefore no exception. Opened in 1969 and classified as a Seveso site, it is losing its production unit (oxygen, nitrogen, argon). "Despite their versatility and unique expertise, the staff are facing mass layoffs. The risk? Increased vulnerability of the oxygen network for local customers." Due to the volumes stored and the nature of the gases, the site is classified as a "Seveso" site, which entails extremely strict safety and monitoring standards.
In Seraing, staff will be asked to produce with half the usual number of employees, while in Liège, the historic headquarters is being emptied in favor of the Lisbon Business Service Center. This is a reality that the staff does not intend to accept without trying everything possible. This Monday, the union delegation is presenting its demands: job security with priority given to internal redeployment within the group; a commitment to employees aged 50 and over with dignified end-of-career solutions or real guarantees of redeployment; and ethical consistency because "a leader in the low-carbon transition cannot leave behind a socially scarred landscape."

El acto se enmarca en un clima de creciente tensión política en España en periodo preelectoral, donde los enfrentamientos verbales entre partidos y simpatizantes se han intensificado en los últimos años. La presencia de manifestantes en actos políticos es habitual, especialmente cuando participan formaciones polarizantes, lo que obliga a desplegar dispositivos de seguridad para evitar incidentes mayores. Se advierte del deterioro del tono en el debate público, con un aumento de los mensajes agresivos tanto en la calle como en redes sociales, lo que contribuye a una mayor crispación política.

Grande mobilisation syndicale ce vendredi 1er mai partout en France. De nombreux rassemblements et défilés sont annoncés dans l’Hexagone à l’occasion de la fête du Travail. Dans le Doubs comme dans le Jura, plusieurs manifestations sont programmées tout au long de la journée. Hausse des salaires, réduction du temps de travail, retraite à 60 ans ou encore défense du caractère férié du 1er mai figurent parmi les principales revendications portées par les organisations syndicales. Les organisateurs souhaitent également mettre l’accent sur la solidarité internationale ainsi que sur la lutte contre les idées d’extrême droite. La rédaction a rencontré Bénédicte Ponçot, co-secrétaire départementale de la FSU 25. Elle rappelle le caractère symbolique et historique de cette journée : « Le 1er mai est une journée particulière. Elle est née des luttes ouvrières au XIXe siècle et reste la seule journée chômée et payée. Comme tous les syndicats, nous le disons clairement : pas touche au 1er mai ».
Inflation et pouvoir d’achat au cœur des préoccupations
Parmi les préoccupations majeures évoquées par les syndicats figure la question du pouvoir d’achat. « L’inflation est une véritable plaie pour les budgets des familles, notamment pour les salariés aux revenus modestes », souligne Bénédicte Ponçot. La responsable syndicale évoque également les difficultés rencontrées par les étudiants, confrontés à des aides insuffisantes malgré la hausse du coût de la vie. La mobilisation de ce 1er mai dépasse également le seul cadre social. L’intersyndicale souhaite dénoncer « les discours homophobes, xénophobes et les idées d’extrême droite qui rongent la société », précise la co-secrétaire départementale de la FSU. Interrogée sur la situation politique locale et l’arrivée d’un élu du Rassemblement national au bureau de Grand Besançon Métropole, Bénédicte Ponçot a indiqué s’exprimer au nom de la FSU : « Pour nous, c’est une véritable claque démocratique ».
Les rassemblements prévus dans la région

CAPTION_ENDORSE: Three schools suspend classes due to rodent infestation in Maullin, Los Lagos, Chile
MESSAGE_TEXT:
La presencia de fecas y avistamientos de roedores ha obligado a las autoridades a paralizar las actividades escolares en el Liceo Francisco Vidal Gormaz, el Liceo de Carelmapu y la Escuela Encarnación Olivares. La comunidad exige soluciones definitivas ante la falta de higiene en los recintos.
Una compleja situación sanitaria enfrenta la educación municipal en Maullín, luego de que durante las últimas horas se confirmara la suspensión de clases en tres recintos educativos debido a una preocupante plaga de roedores.
La crisis afecta a la comunidad escolar de forma transversal:
- Liceo Francisco Vidal Gormaz: La dirección del establecimiento informó esta tarde la suspensión de sus actividades académicas tras el hallazgo de fecas de roedores al interior de sus dependencias, medida adoptada para salvaguardar la salud de alumnos y funcionarios.
- Liceo de Carelmapu: Este recinto ha sido el más afectado, acumulando ya varios días de clases suspendidas. La situación ha llegado a un punto de tensión tal que, esta mañana, apoderados y estudiantes realizaron una manifestación pacífica. Los manifestantes denuncian que la acumulación de basura en los alrededores del liceo actúa como un foco de atracción permanente para los roedores, exigiendo una intervención urgente de las autoridades locales.
- Escuela Encarnación Olivares: El conflicto se trasladó también a este recinto tras detectarse un roedor muerto en las dependencias del edificio colindante (ex DAEM), donde se resguardan instrumentos musicales. Si bien el recinto fue sometido a labores de desratización y limpieza profunda durante este miércoles, el hecho mantiene en alerta a la comunidad.
Comunidad exige medidas preventivas
La proliferación de roedores en los entornos escolares de la comuna ha generado un fuerte malestar ciudadano. Vecinos y apoderados cuestionan la gestión de la basura y la falta de protocolos preventivos, señalando que la suspensión de clases es solo una solución parche ante un problema que requiere un plan de saneamiento estructural en los perímetros de los colegios.
Hasta el momento, los equipos de emergencia y salud municipal se encuentran trabajando en las labores de desinfección. Sin embargo, la comunidad escolar se mantiene a la expectativa, solicitando mayor fiscalización y celeridad en la limpieza de los focos de basura que, según denuncian, son el origen de esta emergencia sanitaria.
TRANSLATED_TEXT:
The presence of rodent droppings and sightings has forced authorities to suspend school activities at the Francisco Vidal Gormaz High School, the Carelmapu High School, and the Encarnación Olivares School. The community is demanding definitive solutions to the lack of hygiene in the schools.
A complex health situation is facing municipal education in Maullín, after the suspension of classes at three educational institutions was confirmed in recent hours due to a worrying rodent infestation.

The crisis is affecting the entire school community:
- Francisco Vidal Gormaz High School: The school administration announced this afternoon the suspension of academic activities after the discovery of rodent droppings inside the premises, a measure adopted to safeguard the health of students and staff.

- Carelmapu High School: This school has been the most affected, accumulating several days of suspended classes. The situation has reached such a point of tension that, this morning, parents and students held a peaceful demonstration. Protesters denounce the accumulation of garbage around the high school, which acts as a constant magnet for rodents, and demand urgent intervention from local authorities.

- Encarnación Olivares School: The conflict also spread to this school after a dead rodent was found in the adjacent building (formerly the DAEM), where musical instruments are stored. Although the school underwent rodent control and deep cleaning on Wednesday, the incident has the community on alert.

Community demands preventative measures
The proliferation of rodents in the school environments of the district has generated strong public concern. Residents and parents question garbage management and the lack of preventative protocols, stating that suspending classes is only a temporary solution to a problem that requires a structural sanitation plan for the areas surrounding schools.
Currently, municipal emergency and health teams are working on disinfection efforts. However, the school community remains vigilant, demanding greater oversight and a faster cleanup of the garbage hotspots that, they claim, are the source of this health emergency.

MESSAGE_TEXT:
La jornada comenzó con una marcha pacífica hacia el barrio Gerona en la zona 1 de la ciudad capital, en donde se encuentra ubicada la sede central del Ministerio Público, para rechazar la gestión de Consuelo Porras y denunciar la criminalización contra el movimiento estudiantil. Durante la protesta, señalaron los procesos penales abiertos tras el fraude en la rectoría de la USAC y exigieron a la nueva administración del MP poner fin a las acciones contra estudiantes, periodistas, pueblos indígenas y defensores de derechos humanos.
Por Alexander Valdéz
A primera hora de este sábado, un grupo de estudiantes de la Universidad de San Carlos realizó una marcha pacífica que recorrió distintas calles y avenidas de la zona 1 capitalina hasta llegar al barrio Gerona, frente al Ministerio Público (MP). Con pancartas, consignas y mensajes de rechazo, los estudiantes señalaron que la manifestación buscaba visibilizar el descontento por los ocho años de gestión de Consuelo Porras.
Durante la actividad, los estudiantes denunciaron la criminalización impulsada contra el movimiento estudiantil de la USAC que se opone a la imposición de Walter Mazariegos como rector. También recordaron los procesos penales abiertos contra estudiantes y profesionales señalados tras la toma de las instalaciones universitarias en 2022.
“El motivo de esta marcha es exigir a la nueva administración del Ministerio Público que ya no siga criminalizando a las y los estudiantes, a los defensores de los derechos humanos, a los pueblos indígenas, ambientalistas y a los periodistas”, expresaron.
La movilización estudiantil se sumó a otra convocatoria realizada por ciudadanos y organizaciones de sociedad civil a las afueras del ente investigador, donde se desarrolló una celebración simbólica para despedir la gestión de Porras. También exigieron a las nuevas autoridades del MP no replicar los patrones de criminalización y persecución denunciados en los últimos años contra estudiantes, operadores de justicia, periodistas, activistas y defensores de derechos humanos.
En Quetzaltenango
Al igual que en Gerona, el centro de Quetzaltenango se convirtió en un segundo punto de encuentro para distintos colectivos sociales, estudiantes, autoridades indígenas y ciudadanos que realizaron actividades de protesta en rechazo a la gestión de Porras al frente del Ministerio Público. Con pancartas, consignas y pronunciamientos públicos, los asistentes manifestaron su descontento por los años de criminalización y persecución contra diversos sectores sociales y políticos del país.
En sus intervenciones, exigieron al nuevo fiscal general garantizar el respeto a los derechos humanos, detener las acciones de persecución judicial y crear condiciones para el retorno seguro de periodistas, defensores de derechos humanos y operadores de justicia que permanecen en el exilio.
Nuevo fiscal general
A partir de este domingo, Gabriel García Luna asumirá las riendas del MP, con altas expectativas por el cese a la criminalización y la recuperación de la confianza en el sistema de justicia. La salida de Porras ocurre en medio de fuertes cuestionamientos nacionales e internacionales sobre el rumbo que tomó el MP durante los últimos años, marcado por decisiones que provocaron un retroceso autoritario.
La Sociedad civil ha señalado que durante esta administración de ocho años se debilitó la carrera fiscal, se desarticularon investigaciones de corrupción y se impulsaron procesos de criminalización contra operadores de justicia, periodistas, activistas, defensores de derechos humanos y estudiantes de la Universidad de San Carlos.
Los cambios y reestructuraciones fueron una constante durante la gestión de Porras. Fiscales y exfiscales denunciaron de forma constante despidos, traslados y reubicaciones de personal especializado sin procesos disciplinarios previos, especialmente contra trabajadores considerados incómodos para la administración.
Los primeros nombramientos de Gabriel García Luna en el MP
Junto al nuevo fiscal general también asumirán nuevos funcionarios en cargos clave, entre los nombres que se empezaron a conocer este fin de semana están: Edwin Santiago Chavajay Chavajay será el secretario general; Shirley García Ovalle estará al frente de la Secretaría de Asuntos Internacionales y Cooperación; Salvador Guzmán asumirá como primer subsecretario general; y Rony López Galindo dirigirá la Secretaría de Asuntos Informáticos.
Las actividades de expresión artística continuarán toda la tarde y noche de este sábado hasta la medianoche. A esa hora se quemarán fuegos artificiales para anunciar el cambio de gestión frente al MP.
